caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted figure of an eagle perched on a rectangular pedestal. The eagle is detailed with defined feathers and is shown in a seated position; its wings are partially open and its head is turned to the left. In front of the eagle, there is an ornate shield that features decorative scrollwork along the edges. The shield and eagle are both rendered with blue and light grey tones. The pedestal supporting the eagle and shield is rectangular with beveled edges and is decorated with blue marbling or splotches over a lighter base. The background of the drawing is a plain, unadorned off-white color. The overall composition is centered, and at the bottom right corner, the name "ADOLF OPSTAD" is written in small capitals.
title: Potpourri Jar: Eagle
